# 4.0 fluent symbol ledger

<!-- Generated by Build/ApiMap/FluentLedger. Do not edit; change the rules or fluent-ledger.json and regenerate. -->

One row per exported member and overload of every authoring receiver, with its proposed 4.0 form under the [#3344](https://github.com/EvotecIT/OfficeIMO/issues/3344) maps. 
Built from the Release assemblies for net10.0, netstandard2.0. Treatments and flags are described in [the ledger tool's README](../FluentLedger/README.md).

- net10.0: 4770 public types, 1186 authoring receivers, 19110 members
- netstandard2.0: 4759 public types, 1186 authoring receivers, 19099 members
